auth.loginSubtitle: Sign in to the console with your registered email address and password.
auth.registerSubtitle: Sign up with your email address. Your account is created once the email is verified.
auth.codePlaceholder: Enter the code from the email
auth.codeSent: If this email address can be registered, a verification code has been sent. Check your inbox.
auth.inviteCodePlaceholder: Enter an invite code if you have one
auth.inviteInvalid: This invite code is invalid. Check the code or clear it to continue signing up.
auth.invitePromotionPaused: Promotion is currently paused for this invite code. Try another code or clear it to continue signing up.
auth.forgotSubtitle: Enter your registered email address and we will send you a link to reset your password.
auth.resetSent: If this email address is registered, a password reset link has been sent.
auth.resetSentDetail: Check your inbox and open the link soon. If it does not arrive, check your spam folder or resend it later.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Choose a new password. Your old password and signed-in sessions stop working afterwards.
reset.doneBody: Sign in with your new password.
reset.invalidTitle: This reset link cannot be used
reset.invalidBody: The link is invalid, already used, or expired. Request a new reset link.

recover.title: Recover your account
recover.subtitle: Set a new password for your account. Afterwards, sign in with the email address that received this message. Your old password and signed-in sessions stop working.
recover.doneBody: Sign in with the email address that received the recovery email and your new password.
recover.invalidTitle: This recovery link cannot be used
recover.invalidBody: The link is invalid, already used, or expired. Ask operations to send it again, or request a new link through password reset.

auth.passwordTooShort: The password must be at least 12 characters long
auth.logoutBody: You will need to sign in again to use the console.
auth.passwordTooLong: The password must not exceed 1024 bytes
auth.registeredSignInFailed: Your account was created, but signing in automatically failed: {reason} Sign in to continue.
auth.opsLogoutHint: Sign in again to continue using the operations console.

showcase.headline: Global residential proxy network

network.title: Rotating & static in one place
network.desc: Non-expiring pay-per-GB traffic alongside dedicated and shared static IPs.

access.title: Standard SOCKS5 sub-accounts

billing.title: Unified wallet & clear ledger
